chunks: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام said:
"There are three things which, if a person knows them, he will not abandon: trimming the hair, shortening the garment, and marrying bondwomen."

key_terms.تَشْمِيرُ الثَّوْبِ: shortening or tucking up the garment
key_terms.عَرَفَهُنَّ: came to know and understand them

ai.seo_question: What are the three practices Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام said a person would not abandon if he understood them?
ai.summary: Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام mentions three practices that a person who properly understands them will continue to observe. The report presents them as matters whose benefit or wisdom becomes evident to one who truly knows them.
